claims.text: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 into public beta via its API on 31 July 2026, a re-post-trained update of V4-Flash aimed at improved agentic, coding and tool-use performance
claims.reasoning: Tier-0 primary source (DeepSeek's own API updates log) dated 31 July 2026 states this directly; corroborated same-day by Nikkei Asia's independently bylined report.

claims.reasoning: April preview confirmed via DeepSeek's own news page. Absence of any V4-Pro entry in DeepSeek's 31 July updates log confirms V4-Pro was not touched -- avoids the candidate framing's conflation of 'V4 and V4 Flash' as a joint July launch.

claims.text: DeepSeek reports V4-Flash-0731 scoring 82.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, 54.4 on DeepSWE, and 70.3 on Toolathlon

claims.reasoning: Directly matches DeepSeek's own pricing page.

claims.text: The release comes amid intensifying price competition among frontier AI labs, landing the same week OpenAI cut prices on GPT-5.6 Luna by roughly 80%
claims.reasoning: Independence check (wire-exclusive rule, verification.md section 2): Nikkei Asia and VentureBeat are separately bylined/reported outlets, not one wire relayed multiple ways -- passes the independence rule for a business claim needing two independent Tier <=2 sources.
